## Product Requirements Document

# PRD: Sprint 1 – Deploy Your First App

## Overview
Create a public-facing portfolio website deployed via GitHub Pages (or Vercel) based on the provided template. This portfolio will be enhanced throughout the course.

## Goals
- Successfully deploy a basic portfolio site using a template repository.
- Link portfolio to GitHub and deploy site to Vercel.
- Prepare for future enhancements.

## Functional Requirements
- Fork the template repo and name it `portfolio`.
- Connect the repo to GitHub Pages/Vercel for deployment.
- Customize the following pages:
  - `index.qmd` (Home) with personal info/photo.
  - `about.qmd` (About) with a short bio.
  - `project-1.qmd` with links to your GitHub repo and Vercel app.
- Update favicon and metadata as needed.

## Success Criteria
- Portfolio is publicly available at GitHub Pages or Vercel domain.
- All required pages are updated with real content.
- Site is "client ready" (no broken links, personalized content, professional presentation).
